notes.title: Mayhem in Single Valley: Confessions 1hr+ demo NOW available on Steam!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1282600/Mayhem_in_Single_Valley_Confessions/

If you are a fan of You Are Not a Banana and thought - what if this guy had a budget? a team? time to actually polish a game? Then you will love Mayhem in Single Valley. I've been working on Mayhem over the last 5 years, officially with a team since March 2018 and the have joined forces with publisher tinyBuild ːsteamhappyː

We hope to launch late 2020 but in the meantime we have created a free 1hr + demo selection pack of levels for you to try called Mayhem in Single Valley: Confessions. Please wishlist, spread the word and provide us with feedback on the demo. Happy gaming - Brian : )

https://store.steampowered.com/app/622680/Mayhem_in_Single_Valley/

notes.title: BETTER EDITION now live (it's about time) and on SALE too!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7937509/eaa32c70119ed4d84cfce5f1f334de492244653b.gif[/img]

I finally got around to releasing the Better Edition : ) I've really tried to address all of the feedback the game received. I hope to add further improvements and content over time. I also want to add a speed run and treasure hunt mode. Below is a list of some of the new features and improvements. Thank you for playing and please spread the word. ːsteamhappyː

BETTER EDITION FEATURES
• Linux support
• Rebuilt the entire game from the ground up : )
• 25 unique Steam achievements
• Autosave, manual save options, and instant checkpoint loading
• Revamped menus and UI (such separate music and sfx volume controls)
• Lots of secrets and hidden story events
• Improved minigames
• More fluid movement and interactions
• New dynamic lighting system
• Revamped animations and graphics (pixel AA filtering and widescreen assets)
• Revamped controls and new moves - such as run and search inventory : )
• 50% funnier jokes

P.S. New trailer [strike]coming soon![/strike] out now : )

notes.title: You Are Not A Banana: Better Edition!
notes.content:
Working on You Are Not A Banana: Better Edition in my spare time (whilst trying to get Mayhem In Single Valley to full production) - new lighting system, save option, dialogue system, improved mini-games, jokes, etc. All improvements are based on the feedback I've received to date. Hope to add achievements and some kind of speed run timer too. Revisiting old code and graphics with new skills is strangely satisfying. It will be available as a major update - so obviously no extra purchase required. May take a few months yet as I am still working alone on all this. ːsteamhappyː
Happy gaming - Brian

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7937509/2a2843a2bf6a6483dccfc6700206aaf02ce8b496.gif[/img]

notes.title: Quick update on my new game Mayhem In Single Valley
notes.content:
I've been very busy developing my new game [url=http://fluxscopic.com/mayhem-in-single-valley/] Mayhem In Single Valley [/url]. I can confirm the game has player stats, basic crafting, a quest manager, a proper save option, plus some J.J. Abrams-esque secret stuff I can't speak about right now : )

If you haven't seen the [url=http://fluxscopic.com/mayhem-in-single-valley/] official homepage [/url] yet, why not check it out? You'll discover screenshots, animation previews, teaser posters, a dev blog, and more. The game is turning out to me a mix between Undertale and The Last Of Us - seriously!

Enjoy - Brian

Ps New music and a early video demo coming soon!

notes.title: Thanks for the feedback so far!
notes.content:
I have read all the reviews (positive and negative - ouch!) so far. I thought I would share a list of improvements that I will be adding to the spiritual successor I am developing called  [i]Mayhem In Single Valley[/i]. First off, everything in the [i]You Are Not A Banana[/i] was made by one person (me) and there were many limitations in terms of time, resources, and know-how, when making my first game. However, for [i]Mayhem In Single Valley[/i] I am working with a small team. We have decided to build the new game from the ground up so we can incorporate the following improvements based on your comments regarding YNB. 
[list]
[*]A save option – as the game will be a lot longer and there will be lots more areas to explore/discover.
[*]An inventory system (and hopefully some basic crafting).
[*]Enemies and boss battles to keep you on your toes. 
[*]A faster pace with more moves and environmental interactions.
[*]An in-depth story with a variety of weird and wonderful fleshed out characters.
[*]Stats based combat and character progression. 
[*]A hint system for those trickier puzzles.
[*]Lots of special level-up items, modes of transport, and mini games. 
[/list]
Thank you for your support so far. More news and previews coming soon.
Happy gaming - Brian

Don't forget to send me your thoughts on how you'd like to see the game evolve and I'll do my best to make it happen.
